## Recall · Lecture 1

a) Which part fills up when a player installs ten games?
b) Which part forgets the running game when the phone turns off?
c) Which device class has a gamepad, a TV and long sessions at home?

::: {.answer}
a) storage
b) RAM
c) console
:::

## Activity 1 · Two starts · 10 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A game starts from storage and runs in RAM.
- **Do it:** Close a game fully and time its start. Then open it again from the recent apps and time it again.
- Why is the second start faster?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/launch.png)
:::
::::

## Check 1 · Two starts

Why is the second start faster?

::: {.reveal}
1. The first start takes several seconds, for example 8 s.
2. The phone reads the game from storage into RAM the first time.
3. The second time, the game is still in RAM, so it opens in less than a second.
:::

## Activity 2 · Two screens · 10 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- The screen is the main output device of a game.
- The resolution counts the pixels, and the refresh rate counts the pictures per second.
- **Do it:** Find the resolution and the refresh rate of the lab screen and of your phone.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/von-neumann.png)
:::
::::

## Check 2 · Two screens

What do typical screens show?

::: {.reveal}
1. A lab screen often has 1920 × 1080 pixels and 60 Hz.
2. A phone often has 2400 × 1080 pixels and 90 or 120 Hz.
3. A phone can have more pixels than a lab screen.
:::

## Activity 3 · The right device · 10 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Sky Puzzle has 3-minute levels for one finger, Iron Fleet has 2-hour battles with keys and a mouse, and Couch Kart is for four friends with gamepads on one TV.
- **Do it:** Choose the device class for each game, with one reason.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/devices.png)
:::
::::

## Check 3 · The right device

Which device class fits each game?

::: {.reveal}
1. Sky Puzzle fits a smartphone, because its sessions are short and use touch.
2. Iron Fleet fits a PC, because it needs a keyboard, a mouse and long sessions.
3. Couch Kart fits a console, because four gamepads share one TV.
:::

## Try it · One game, many devices (harder)

The facts: the class plays on Android phones, iPhones, Windows laptops, one console and a cloud gaming service.

a) How many builds does the studio need for the phones, the laptops and the console?
b) Where does the game run for the cloud players?
c) In which device class does heat matter most in a 30-minute session?

::: {.answer}
a) 4
b) on a server
c) smartphone
:::

## Wrap-up

- You can explain a slow and a fast game start with storage and RAM.
- You can read the resolution and the refresh rate of a screen.
- You can choose a device class for a game and give a reason.
